about: Board fixtures for scripts/shell-measure-proof.mjs --fixtures (TCRN-DS-SUB-135). The two finished Shell boards are measured in place (their bytes are the truth; nothing is copied here) with the board hooks of scripts/lib/shell-measure.mjs, at the boards' own screen width (1240, phones 390) in a 1240 x 900 viewport. Every gate must be green on the boards; mutations.json turns each gate red. Behaviour cannot be read from a board, so the intro, focus-loop and outside-click halves are judged on the traces below (the board's stated behaviour); on the package stories the probes of scripts/shell-measure-proof.mjs record the same traces on the real parts (stories.behaviour, TCRN-DS-SUB-137). This manifest does not touch ../manifest.json.

intro.source: G 段登入动画（每会话 1 次；刷新 0 次；reduced-motion 下 0 次）；Shell 板 C 段（只用 transform 与 opacity）；C-2 motion.intro 上限 700ms

focusLoop.source: G 段焦点回路（Esc 后回标按钮；⌘K 后到搜索框；← → 在级联列间移动）；C-7（⌘K / Ctrl+K 每个壳只注册一次）

outsideClick.source: G 段无收起钮、无常驻侧栏（点外部关闭）；C-7 临时浮层（点外部、Esc、选中即收）

stories.about: Package-story side (TCRN-DS-SUB-137). screens: the screens each C-9 story must show, in order, with the C-5 data-state of the shell root (the board screen names of the TCRN-DS-SUB-121 stories; ts-m-s is the board's Sheet screen, so its root reads sheet). behaviour: where the probes run, the focus loop and outside click on a closed screen and the arrows on a screen that shows the full menu; the intro on the intro story in a fresh session.
